title.title: Polyakov's mass gap and the $O(3)$ continuum limit
title.subtitle: Claim: 2D $O(n)$ spin correlations decay exponentially at every temperature, for every $n \ge 3$

lines.note: also claimed: the exact square-lattice $O(4)$ gap

beats.text: Schematically: for $n = 2$ correlations decay like a power, for $n \ge 3$ exponentially
Polyakov, 1975: a mass gap from nothing, at every temperature however low
The form Hasenfratz, Maggiore and Niedermayer predicted from the Bethe ansatz
